message.content: Build a TESTIMONIALS CMS (real social proof), a LIVE-CHAT widget scaffold, and marketing perf polish for Nxeon at /opt/nxeon. Other agents edit OTHER areas concurrently — touch ONLY YOUR OWNED FILES. ## PRIMER Next.js 15 + Prisma. `"use server"` = async-only. `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`; admin `import { requireArea } from "@/lib/rbac"` → `requireArea("platform")`. Design: `.card`,`.input`,`.btn-*`,`.table-shell`; `import { PageHeader, Badge } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`; marketing helpers `import { SectionHeading } from "@/components/marketing/sections"`. NEW model `Testimonial{ author, role?, quote, avatarEmoji?, rating(Int default 5), published, sortOrder }`. ## TASK 1. **Testimonials CMS** — admin `/admin/testimonials` (`requireArea("platform")`): CRUD real testimonials (author, role, quote, emoji, rating, published toggle, sort). `lib/actions-testimonials.ts` (`"use server"`), `components/admin/TestimonialControls.tsx`. 2. **Render real testimonials on the landing** — EDIT `components/marketing/Testimonials.tsx` (you are the sole editor): fetch `db.testimonial.findMany({ where:{ published:true }, orderBy:{ sortOrder:"asc" } })`; if any exist, render them (author/role/quote/rating stars/emoji) as real social proof; if none, fall back to the existing illustrative use-case cards (keep the honest "illustrative" disclaimer only in the fallback). Note: this component is currently a server component with hardcoded cards — preserve its export name/signature so `app/page.tsx` keeps working. 3. **Live-chat widget** — `components/marketing/LiveChat.tsx` (`"use client"`, default export): env/settings-gated — reads `NEXT_PUBLIC_CRISP_ID` or `NEXT_PUBLIC_TAWK_ID` (or a `livechat_snippet` Setting) and injects the provider snippet via `next/script`; renders nothing if unset. (Orchestrator mounts it in the root layout.) No hard dependency on any provider. 4. **Marketing perf** — within components you own here only, adopt `next/image` where there are raw `` (likely none — note it). Do NOT change `force-dynamic` on pages you don't own. ## OWNED FILES (create/edit ONLY these) CREATE: `lib/actions-testimonials.ts`, `app/admin/testimonials/page.tsx`, `components/admin/TestimonialControls.tsx`, `components/marketing/LiveChat.tsx`. EDIT (sole owner): `components/marketing/Testimonials.tsx`. ## HARD RULES Never touch schema/next.config/layouts/Shell/app/page.tsx/lib(auth/db/rbac)/worker/ROADMAP/docs/sitemap or others' files. No build/prisma/generate/restart/commit. No new deps. `"use server"` = async-only. Testimonials CMS is for REAL testimonials the admin enters — do not fabricate fake named people in seed data. ## REPORT Files created/edited; how the CMS + landing render + live-chat gating work; INTEGRATION NEEDED (mount `` in root layout; nav link `/admin/testimonials`; env/setting for the chat provider); risks.

All files are in place. ## Report Built the Testimonials CMS, LiveChat scaffold, and updated the landing testimonials section for Nxeon. Only owned files touched; no schema/config/layout/build changes. ### Files created - **`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-testimonials.ts`** (`"use server"`) — `saveTestimonial` (create/update via `useActionState`, Zod-validated: author required, quote required, rating coerced/clamped 1–5, sortOrder 0–9999, optional role/emoji nulled when blank), `toggleTestimonialPublish`, `deleteTestimonial`. Each calls `requireArea("platform")`, revalidates `/admin/testimonials` and `/`, logs errors via `logEvent`. Mirrors the existing `actions-blog.ts` pattern. Note: model has no `updatedAt`, so none is written. - **`/opt/nxeon/app/admin/testimonials/page.tsx`** (`force-dynamic`) — `requireArea("platform")`, editor card + table (author/emoji, truncated quote, star rating, sort, published Badge, row actions). Ordered `sortOrder asc, createdAt desc`. `?edit=` loads a row into the form. - **`/opt/nxeon/components/admin/TestimonialControls.tsx`** (`"use client"`) — `TestimonialEditor` form and `TestimonialRowActions` (Edit link, Publish/Hide toggle, confirm-then-delete), matching `BlogControls.tsx`. - **`/opt/nxeon/components/marketing/LiveChat.tsx`** (`"use client"`, default export) — provider-agnostic, renders nothing unless configured. Precedence: optional `snippet` prop (raw snippet from a `livechat_snippet` Setting, passed by a server parent since a client component can't read the DB) → `NEXT_PUBLIC_CRISP_ID` → `NEXT_PUBLIC_TAWK_ID` (`propertyId[/widgetId]`). Injects via `next/script` (`afterInteractive`). No hard provider dependency. ### File edited (sole owner) - **`/opt/nxeon/components/marketing/Testimonials.tsx`** — now an **async** server component (same export name/signature, so `app/page.tsx` `` still works). Fetches `db.testimonial.findMany({ where:{published:true}, orderBy:{sortOrder:"asc"} })`; if any exist, renders them as real social proof (quote, author, role, star rating, emoji avatar) with no disclaimer. If none, falls back to the original illustrative use-case cards **with the honest "illustrative" disclaimer preserved only in the fallback**. Wrapped the query in `.catch(() => [])` for safety. ### How gating/rendering works - **CMS → landing:** admin enters real testimonials; only `published:true` ones appear on the landing, sorted by `sortOrder`. Zero published = honest fallback cards. - **Live chat:** unset env/snippet = `null` (nothing rendered); safe to mount unconditionally. ### Perf No raw `` in any owned component — the landing/testimonials/livechat use SVG, emoji, and CSS only, so no `next/image` migration was applicable. ### Integration needed (orchestrator) 1. Mount `` in the root layout (`app/layout.tsx`). To use the `livechat_snippet` Setting, the layout (a server component) should read it via `getSetting("livechat_snippet")` and pass ``; otherwise env vars alone work. 2. Add an admin nav link to `/admin/testimonials` in `app/admin/layout.tsx` (e.g. `{ label: "Testimonials", href: "/admin/testimonials", icon: "..." }`). 3. Configure a chat provider if wanted: `NEXT_PUBLIC_CRISP_ID`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_TAWK_ID`, or a `livechat_snippet` Setting (+ add `livechat_snippet` to `SETTINGS_DEFAULTS` if surfacing it in the settings UI — not my owned file). ### Risks - Prisma client already contains the `Testimonial` model (verified in `node_modules/.prisma/client`), so `db.testimonial` is live now. - `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` vars are inlined at build time — the chat env vars require a rebuild to take effect (build is out of my scope). - `revalidatePath("/")` assumes the landing lives at `/`; if `app/page.tsx` is statically cached, published changes surface on next revalidation.
